errors.text: The hypothesis localizes the antiferromagnetic Fe/Co/Ni–Ti coupling primarily at the fcc/C14 interface, whereas the target mechanism concerns sublattice coupling and spin canting within the phase-resolved electronic structures, particularly the fcc phase.
Treating the C14 phase as a rigid magnetic, high-anisotropy barrier at 400 K is insufficiently supported because its identified magnetic transitions occur near 214 K and lower.
